title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Cayley per-volume readers with Volume VIII source scan preserved
description:
This record is a public-facing shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Arthur Cayley, Richard Dedekind, and P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet. Top-level PDFs are organized by author and volume/work so readers can download individual compiled reader files directly. Source TeX, source scans, build notes, audit outputs, and provenance material are collected in the artifact ZIP.

Status at a glance.

  • Cayley reader surface: [#########-] front matter plus Volumes I-VII and IX-XIII are clean per-volume compiled readers, 6,389 pages total. Volume VIII has now been located as a source scan and preserved in the artifact ZIP; the modern LaTeX reader for that volume is still pending. Volume II pages 105-156 and Volume XII pages 101-150 remain internal source gaps.
  • Dedekind and Dirichlet reader surface: [######----] Dedekind Bands I-III and one Dirichlet selected-works grouping remain present as working drafts.
  • Technical PDF/display checks: [##########] promoted Cayley PDFs compile and open as normal PDF readers; the previous Cayley readers with literal TeX math command leakage have been replaced.
  • Mathematical proofreading: [----------] working drafts for checking and correction, not certified critical editions.

Workflow. Public-domain scans and witnesses are converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and packaged with source artifacts for inspection and correction. The public organization is by author, work, or corpus; raw process material is kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.
notes: Focused public-facing working-draft shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet. Latest update preserves the Cayley Volume VIII source scan in the artifact ZIP while the modern LaTeX reader remains pending.
